project_type: Spring Boot 3.5.6 microservice with MySQL, Kafka, Eureka, OpenFeign
test_framework: Spring Boot Test with JUnit 5, Mockito
verification_instructions: 1. Run mvn clean compile to ensure code compiles. 2. Run mvn test to run all unit tests. 3. Check that application starts with mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=test. 4. Verify database migrations are applied correctly.
snapshot_or_generated_files: target/classes - compiled classes, target/test-classes - test compiled classes
environment_constraints: MySQL must be running on localhost:3307, Kafka on localhost:9092, Eureka on localhost:8761. Never restart dev server on :8083.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns from account-service. Use Lombok annotations for entities/DTOs. Use Builder pattern for entity creation. Follow package structure: entity, repository, service, controller, dto, config, exception, kafka, feign.
key_patterns: 1. Entities use @Entity, @Table, Lombok annotations (@Getter, @Setter, @NoArgsConstructor, @AllArgsConstructor, @Builder). 2. Services use @Service, constructor injection. 3. Controllers use @RestController, @RequestMapping. 4. DTOs use Lombok @Data or @Getter/@Setter. 5. Kafka configuration follows account-service pattern with ConsumerFactory and KafkaListenerContainerFactory. 6. Repository interfaces extend JpaRepository.
directory_structure: src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/ - main packages: entity (entities), repository (JPA repositories), service (business logic), controller (REST endpoints), dto (data transfer objects), config (configuration classes), exception (custom exceptions), kafka (Kafka producers/consumers). src/test/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/ - test packages mirroring main structure.
